sentences.en: I'm forever lost, can't you see? I'm in a bind!
sentences.zh: 我永远都走不出去了，你看不到吗？我现在处境很尴尬！

sentences.en: This decision is not binding on all of you.
sentences.zh: 这个决定并不约束所有人。

sentences.en: I am in a bind as my money has been stolen.
sentences.zh: 我的钱被偷了，我现在很被动。

senses.zh: 捆绑；困境；讨厌的事情；植物的藤蔓
结合；装订；有约束力；过紧
